Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 1.1: Replying to John about Movie Habits and Action Films
Nội dung chi tiết:
You have received an email from your friend, John, about movies and entertainment. Read part of his email below:

"I am planning a movie night with friends this weekend, and I would love to get your ideas! Do you enjoy watching action movies? How often do you go to the cinema to watch films? Also, is there any particular movie that you have watched recently that you found truly great and worth recommending? I can't wait to hear from you!"

Write an email responding to John. You should write at least 120 words. You do not need to include your name or address.

Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 2.1: Computer Technology in Language Learning
Nội dung chi tiết:
Read the following statement:

"Computer technology and digital applications are increasingly integrated into language learning classrooms and self-study routines."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing the advantages and disadvantages of using computer technology for language learning. Provide specific reasons and examples from your knowledge or experience to support your answer. You should write at least 250 words.
